answer: Each applicant must park slashable collateral in a still lagoon of pending claims that cannot be withdrawn for three epochs. Established peers then fire a beacon of unpredictable, seed-tied re-execution tasks against the published receipt. Only after those hashes match, and no second seat shares the signing path, does the claim open into a lotus of grading weight. A farm of clones therefore pays capital, calendar time, and unique work per fake, instead of minting aliases that vote at once.
